sections.title: 11. FAQs regarding German architecture

items: Q1. Is it possible for me to study architecture in English in Germany?
Yes, especially at the master's level, certain **architecture programs are taught in English**. Check the language requirements carefully because many bachelor's programs need proficiency in German.
Q2. How long does it take to study architecture in Germany?
Master's programs often take **1-2 years**, whereas bachelor's programs typically take **3-4 years**. Professional registration may need more time overall.
Q3. Is architecture reasonably priced in Germany?
There are exceptions to the general tuition fee policy at several **public universities**. Additionally, living expenses, semester contributions, and design supplies must be budgeted for by students.
Q4. Is it possible for Indian students to pursue architecture studies in Germany after the 12th grade?

Yes, if they fulfill the **admission requirements** of the university. Certain applicants may require **Studienkolleg and an assessment examination** based on their educational background. Additionally, a **portfolio or aptitude assessment** might be necessary.
Q5. Can I become a licensed architect after studying in Germany?

Graduates may be able to apply for **professional registration**, the requirements may vary depending on the German state and architecture chamber. It might be required to have a recognized degree, real-world experience, and other requirements.
